name: Reducto
description: Agentic document platform for parsing, extracting, classifying, splitting, and editing documents via API and MCP server.

evidence.claim: Parse, extract, classify, split, and edit documents with a single API and SDKs in Python, Node.js, Go.
Sign up at studio.reducto.ai and create an API key, setting it as REDUCTO_API_KEY.
Official MCP server exists to connect AI agents to Reducto via Model Context Protocol.

notes: Reducto provides SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go, plus a CLI and an official MCP server for AI agents.
